proof.source: Physical source records bind the ordered group-1005 references to a model-space 3DLINE and a named-block MESH with their distinct source owners and exact entity types. Typed import confirms the endpoints, thickness, extrusion, MESH version/flags, ordered vertices and face indices.
proof.output: For each ASCII/binary source/output pair, physical output checks both target types, the selected geometry/topology fields, owner roles and the ordered remapped group-1005 references. A fresh adapter readback checks exact DRW_3DLine and DRW_Mesh dynamic types and their selected fields/topology.
proof.failure_retry: Removing either target independently refuses export and preserves the existing destination; restoring the target permits same-adapter retry. A late mutation of the named-block MESH handle also refuses without replacing the destination and succeeds after restoration.

limits: This qualifies one ordered AC1027 code-1005 pair with a model-space 3DLINE followed by a named-BLOCKS MESH, for the selected ASCII/binary input/output combinations. Other pair orderings, target combinations, source/output sections, versions, code-1005 counts and XDATA profiles remain open.

This is selected source identity, field/topology transport, output/readback and transaction evidence. It does not establish native MESH subdivision or rendering, independent CAD-kernel semantics, complete document closure, or any general DWG/DXF support claim.
